guidance.claim: We will endeavour to maintain the margin guidance between the 18 and 20% band.
guidance.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: We are targeting to train almost 10 lakh people this year.
guidance.quote: This year, as we kind of go ahead, we are gunning for training almost 10 lakh people.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: We target volume growth in the 8 to 10 percent band for Q4.
guidance.quote: I think as we go ahead, this band would remain, in terms of what we would be able to target for the Q4 as well.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: A realistic gap between volume and value going forward is 4 to 5 percent.
guidance.quote: So, I would say that this 4%-5% is a more realistic thing which would remain in the market, so that possibly from a point of view of share you are able to concentrate far more holistically in terms of how the market is growing.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: We drove a strong high single-digit volume growth of 7.9% in Q3.
reported.quote: Coming on to the Q3 results, as you see, we have been able to drive a strong high single -digit volume growth of 7.9% which is strong.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: The value growth was about 2.8% for Q3.
reported.quote: The value growth was about 2.8%, so you can see the difference between the value and the volume was approximately about 5% , which indicates a relatively strong mix in terms of what we have been able to deliver.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Standlone gross margin reached 44.9% in Q3.
reported.quote: At the same time, when we look at the gross margin, one of the highest Gross Margins I would say over the quarters in terms of what we have registered, about 44.9%, 200 bps points higher
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: The consolidated gross margin was 44.3% in Q3.
reported.quote: The Gross Margin is 44.3% which is higher by about 200 bps points.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: We added 3,500 to 4,000 retailers reaching over 1.6 lakh outlets.
reported.quote: W e have added about 3,500 to 4,000 retailers this year overall, and our reach is now in more than 1.6 lakh retail outlets.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: New products contribute about 16% of overall revenues.
reported.quote: And today , new product contributes to about 16% of our overall revenues.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
